title: Add fee, discount or tax
purpose: Append one manual fee, discount or tax assessment to an active internal draft invoice, with a reason and retained history.
summary: Add a fee, discount or tax assessment to an active draft invoice. Only project managers and admins can add lines; the draft remains internal.

tasks.title: Add a charge
steps: Choose Fee in [[Kind]] and enter a [[Description]].
Enter [[Reason for change]] and select [[Add fee, discount or tax]].

tasks.title: Record a discount
steps: Choose Discount in [[Kind]] and describe the adjustment.
Enter a positive whole-number [[Quantity]] and zero or a negative [[Unit price]].
Give a reason and select [[Add fee, discount or tax]]. Review the total on the draft.

tasks.title: Record an explicit tax assessment
steps: Choose Tax in [[Kind]] and identify its basis or source in [[Description]].
Keep [[Quantity]] at 1 and enter the nonnegative whole-cent USD assessment in [[Unit price]].
Enter [[Reason for change]] and select [[Add fee, discount or tax]].

tasks.title: Leave without adding a line
steps: Select [[Cancel]] to return to the draft without saving.

good_to_know: Fees and tax use nonnegative whole-cent USD amounts; discounts use zero or negative amounts. Tax quantity must be 1.
Tax never recalculates when charges change. Review each assessment separately. A missing tax line makes no tax determination.
Multiple tax assessments may be separate lines. Zero retains an explicit assessment; there are no rates, exemptions or automatic taxability decisions.
Every saved line remains. Use Edit to correct an unwanted amount to zero with a reason. All lines share the 200-line limit and a nonnegative total.
A draft must still be active and have the same revision. Reload and check the current status if another person makes changes.

sections.title: Access and purpose
paragraphs: Only project managers and administrators may open this form or add a line, including through a direct link. Clients and other staff are refused. Only an active draft can receive lines. Issued, voided and cancelled records remain readable with their saved charges. This form works for drafts created from either a price list or an accepted quote. It does not issue an invoice, bill a client, calculate tax or payments, or change receipt, analytical work or reports.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Required choice: Fee, Discount or Tax. Test lines cannot be added here. The selected kind remains fixed after saving.

items.label: Description
items.description: Required text up to 400 characters, trimmed around the edges. Explain the charge or discount; for tax, identify the basis or source of the entered assessment.

items.label: Quantity
items.description: Required positive whole number from 1 to 2,147,483,647, initially 1. Tax must be exactly 1, so its unit price is the whole assessment. Other kinds multiply quantity by unit price; source counts do not change.

items.label: Unit price
items.description: Required signed whole-cent USD amount, at most 9,999,999,999.99 in magnitude. Fees and tax must be nonnegative; discounts must be zero or negative. A zero tax amount retains an explicit assessment. No percentage or currency conversion is performed.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Required explanation up to 2000 characters, retained with the adding staff member, time and before/after draft values.

items.label: Add fee, discount or tax
items.description: Append one line after the existing lines, recompute the exact USD total, and save it with an attributed history event. Each line amount must fit 999,999,999,999.99 USD in magnitude; the final total must be between zero and that limit. All lines together are limited to 200. The form rejects a stale revision, inactive draft, invalid tax quantity, invalid sign or negative total. Success returns to the draft record.

items.label: Manually added
items.description: On the draft and edit pages this identifies a staff-added fee, discount or tax assessment with no quote, sample or requested-test source. Existing quote and test sources are preserved. Every line retains its kind and origin through edits and cancellation. Lines cannot be deleted; correct an unwanted amount to zero with a reason.

items.label: Errors and concurrent changes
items.description: Errors appear above the form or beside a field, with entered values preserved and focus on the error. Nothing is partially saved when validation or audit recording fails. If someone adds, edits, issues or cancels while the form is open, reload and review the draft before submitting again.

items.label: Cancel / Close form
items.description: Leave without adding a line. A dialog with changed input offers Keep editing or Discard changes. Cancel here does not cancel the draft invoice.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size / Try again
items.description: Resize the dialog without saving or retry a failed dialog load. The dialog uses the full screen at narrow widths. Wait for saving to finish before continuing.

items.label: Draft invoices / draft number
items.description: Breadcrumb links return to the directory or draft record without adding a line.

sections.title: Due dates
paragraphs: Adding a line preserves the draft’s optional staff-entered due date. To set, change or clear that date, use Edit on the draft record and give a reason. Payment terms do not calculate it.

sections.title: Explicit tax assessments
paragraphs: Tax assessments are entered manually on an active draft through Add fee, discount or tax. Each requires a description identifying its basis or source, quantity exactly 1 and a nonnegative whole-cent USD amount. Multiple assessments may be separate lines. Tax lines have no quote, sample or requested-test source. Creation from a price list or accepted quote never creates a tax line.

There are no tax rates, taxability or exemption decisions, or automatic tax calculations. The exact draft total includes every entered assessment. Changing test, fee or discount charges never recalculates tax: review each tax assessment separately after changing charges. Zero retains an explicit assessment; a missing tax line makes no tax determination. Tax lines cannot be deleted or change kind; correct an amount to zero with a reason. Cancellation retains the lines and their history.
